query: I just spent the whole morning baking chocolate chip cookies for my kid’s school bake sale, and I’m really proud of how they turned out—they’re perfectly chewy in the middle with crispy edges, and I even added a dash of sea salt on top. I also had to stop by the pet store on my way home to pick up a new scratching post for my cat, who’s been tearing up the couch lately, and the staff there gave me a free sample of salmon treats that he went crazy for as soon as I walked in the door. I also finally got around to planting the sunflower seeds I bought last month in the backyard, and I’m already excited to see how tall they grow by the end of summer. I’m having an issue with my phone right now, I can’t use any mobile services at all. I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my SIM card is locked with a PIN that I haven’t been able to get past, my line was suspended a few days ago because I have an overdue bill, and I think the SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me fix this?
